author: EmanueleCoradin
body:
#### PR description:
This PR adds PyTorch inference support for the Alpaka ROCm backend in the heterogeneous PhysicsTools/PyTorchAlpaka package.

Previously, PyTorchAlpaka supported PyTorch inference on the serial and CUDA backends, while the ROCm backend fell back to CPU inference. This PR allows the same PyTorch models to run directly on AMD GPUs through ROCm/HIP.

The implementation keeps the existing Alpaka interface and extends the backend-specific PyTorch integration to ROCm.

#### Dependencies

This PR depends on [#121](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw-config/pull/121)

#### PR validation:
The test units have been extended to the ROCm backend.
**Failure**: In the `TinyResNet` test, PyTorch is failing to run the convolution kernels
title: Extend support to AMD GPUs in the PyTorchAlpaka Package
